title: Moony's Magical Tobacco
description: Retextures Smoking Stuff's Magical Herb to look more like tobacco, also retextures the Big Tube into a cigar.
body:
DON'T SMOKE. IT'S BAD FOR YOUR LUNGS.

Retextures [Smoking Stuff](https://modrinth.com/mod/smoking-stuff-a-wizards-hobby)'s Magical Herb to look more like tobacco and also retextures the Big Tube into a cigar.

Crate texture modified from [Farmer's Delight](https://github.com/vectorwing/FarmersDelight). Best paired with the [official alternative textures](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/smoking-stuff-alternative), just put this pack **ABOVE** it in the resource pack page.
